# Genesis integration inbox

A holding area for files Timothy selects for possible later integration.

Files placed here are pending review. Placement does not activate algorithms, amend Genesis invariants, finalize glyph definitions, or establish the correctness of source claims. Runtime imports and registries are unchanged.

## Current intake

- [Hebrew algorithm set](hebrew-algorithm-set/ECHO_GlyphRegistry/INDEX.md): 22 individual glyph documents plus the original index.
- [Source and preservation record](hebrew-algorithm-set/PROVENANCE.json).
- [Unmodified source archive](hebrew-algorithm-set/ECHO_GlyphRegistry.zip).

The Hebrew set was copied from `ECHO_GlyphRegistry.zip` on `dev-suite-algorithms` at commit `03978f7eec1950e3a587fb29dea199227d61428a`. The Library also holds an index at `Algorithms/Stress-Test-001/input/glyph-registry-INDEX.md` on `code-library-registry`; that index is a related source, not a replacement for the archived version.

The source documents combine proposed algorithms, claimed existing counterparts, composition rules, and research interpretations. Their wording is preserved verbatim, including inconsistencies and unverified linguistic or capability claims. They are documentation, not 22 independently verified executable modules.

For future intake, keep each selected set in its own folder with its source branch, commit, original path, and review status. Integration remains a separate decision directed by Timothy.
